sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: marbot.app ("we") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when using our services. By using marbot.app, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

sections.title: 2. Data We Collect
items: Account data: name, email, and profile information you provide when registering.
Mosque data: mosque name, address, location coordinates, and mosque profile information.
Operational data: congregation data, financial transactions, activities, and other data you enter into the application.
Technical data: IP address, browser type, and log data for security and performance purposes.

sections.title: 3. Data Usage
sections.note: We never sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: 4. Data Storage & Security
sections.content: Data is stored on servers located in Singapore with industry-standard encryption. Each mosque has a separate database — data between mosques is never mixed. We perform daily backups and periodic security audits.

sections.title: 5. Your Rights
items: Access and download data we store about you.
Request data deletion (subject to applicable regulations).
Stop using the service at any time.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.content: We use cookies to maintain login sessions and your preferences. We do not use third-party tracking cookies for advertising.

sections.title: 7. Policy Changes
sections.content: We may update this policy from time to time. Significant changes will be communicated via email or in-app notifications.

sections.title: 8. Contact
sections.content: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at admin@marbot.app.
